owner_direction: Show both orderings to expose the tradeoffs
comparison_universe: the same selected 25 candidates in each lens; not an exhaustive global comparison
coverage_gaps: Science, mathematics, economics, religion, art, biography and historical writing remain underrepresented. Bible/Qur’an/other composite scriptures, Euclid, Newton, Marx, Smith and major histories require explicit work-boundary decisions and fuller dossiers. Their absence is not a negative assessment. This comparison cannot yet establish a worldwide Top 25.
tradeoffs: Darwin moves from 3 to 22: this scenario gives direct contemporary reading experience more priority than the historical importance of a scientific argument.
Middlemarch moves from 12 to 1, while Critique of Pure Reason moves from 8 to 25: engagement and preparation change priority without changing the underlying evidence.
The Falling Sky moves from 24 to 14: this is a tentative case for widening intellectual encounter, with particularly incomplete book-level evidence.
